cases.translation: There was a man with a withered hand.
cases.explain: Человек is the subject of был (there was) → nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.translation: Jesus heals the man with the withered hand.
cases.explain: Человек is the direct object of исцеляет (heals); being an animate masculine noun, its accusative matches the genitive: человека.

cases.sentence: За ними следовало великое множество народа из Галилеи, Иудеи, Иерусалима, Идумеи, из-за ___ Иордана, из окрестностей Тира и Сидона.
cases.translation: A great multitude followed from Galilee, Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, from beyond the Jordan river, and from around Tyre and Sidon.
cases.explain: The preposition из-за (from beyond) governs the genitive → реки.

cases.sentence: А Иисус пошел с учениками к ___.
cases.translation: And Jesus went with his disciples to the lake.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) always takes the dative → озеру.

cases.translation: Jesus went with his disciples to the lake.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → учениками, the instrumental plural of ученик.

cases.sentence: ...потому что они говорили, он не в своем ___.
cases.translation: ...because they said he was out of his mind.
cases.explain: В marking a state (в уме — 'in one's mind') takes the prepositional → уме.

reading.ru: Фарисеи внимательно наблюдали за ним, не исцелит ли он этого человека в субботу, чтобы потом обвинить его.
reading.question: Why were the Pharisees watching Jesus closely in the synagogue?
options: To see if he would heal on the Sabbath so they could accuse him
To learn how to heal the sick themselves
reading.correct: To see if he would heal on the Sabbath so they could accuse him
reading.explain: The Pharisees watched to see whether Jesus would heal on the Sabbath, so that they could accuse him.

reading.ru: Выйдя из синагоги, фарисеи немедленно начали совещаться со сторонниками Ирода о том, как им убить Иисуса.
reading.question: What did the Pharisees do immediately after leaving the synagogue?
options: They began plotting with the Herodians to kill Jesus
They went to warn the crowd
They followed Jesus to the sea
reading.correct: They began plotting with the Herodians to kill Jesus
reading.explain: Leaving the synagogue, the Pharisees immediately conspired with the Herodians about how to kill Jesus.

reading.ru: За ними следовало великое множество народа из Галилеи, Иудеи, Иерусалима, Идумеи, из-за реки Иордана, из окрестностей Тира и Сидона.
reading.question: From how wide an area did the crowds following Jesus come?
options: From Galilee, Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, beyond the Jordan, and around Tyre and Sidon
reading.correct: From Galilee, Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, beyond the Jordan, and around Tyre and Sidon
reading.explain: A great multitude followed him from Galilee, Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, beyond the Jordan, and the region of Tyre and Sidon.

reading.ru: А те, в ком были нечистые духи, когда видели Его, падали перед Ним ниц и кричали «Ты Сын Бога!»
reading.question: What did people with unclean spirits do and say when they saw Jesus?
options: They fell down before him and cried out, "You are the Son of God!"
reading.correct: They fell down before him and cried out, "You are the Son of God!"
reading.explain: Those with unclean spirits fell down before him and cried out, "You are the Son of God!"

reading.question: What did Jesus do after going up the mountain and calling those he wanted?
options: He appointed twelve men as apostles
He taught a parable about seeds
reading.correct: He appointed twelve men as apostles
reading.explain: Jesus went up the mountain, called those he wanted, and appointed twelve men to be his apostles.

reading.ru: Услышав об этом, родственники Иисуса пришли забрать его, потому что они говорили, он не в своем уме, а учители закона, пришедшие из Иерусалима, утверждали.
reading.question: Why did Jesus' relatives come to take charge of him?
options: Because they said he was out of his mind
Because he asked them to come
reading.correct: Because they said he was out of his mind
reading.explain: His relatives came to take him because they said he was out of his mind.

reading.ru: Но тот, кто будет хулить Святого Духа, тому не простится никогда.
reading.question: According to Jesus, what sin will never be forgiven?
reading.explain: Jesus says whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven.

reading.ru: Кто исполняет Божью волю, тот мне и брат, и сестра, и мать».
reading.question: Whom does Jesus call his true mother and brothers?
reading.explain: Jesus says whoever does God's will is his brother, sister, and mother.
